purpose: Accepted B UI design reference only; runtime UI uses native Godot controls and existing sprites.
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: preview-only high fidelity design proposal for a Godot Korean chibi auto-battle survival game's in-run shop. This is a visual concept, not an implemented screenshot.
Canvas: one full landscape screen with exact 915:412 aspect ratio, upscale resolution permitted. Entire screen visible, no phone or desktop frame, no margin outside the screen, no comparison collage.
Game: 서울 히어로. The UI should feel bright, premium, playful, designed for Galaxy S24 Ultra landscape. Strong visual hierarchy, crisp large Korean typography and generous spacing. The surrounding game is cute SD with empty-handed large-head tiny-body characters and friendly monsters.
Functional content: one shop screen, header title "게이트24", small "웨이브 06", cyan crystal currency "1,280", pause icon at upper right. Left sidebar: small cute black-haired male chibi portrait wearing a dark outfit and a teal scarf, title "송진우", "120 / 120", a HP bar, and a SHORT vertical summary "피해 +24%" "공격 속도 +15%" "방어력 12" "이동 속도 110"; a clear "전체 스탯" action. Main area: tabs "무기" and selected "아이템", a "재진열 20" button with a clear circular-arrow icon. Exactly FOUR equal item offers across in ONE row: can drink "에너지 드링크" with "공격 속도 +5%" and price 14; white rice triangle "삼각김밥" with "최대 체력 +6" and price 11; mint and yellow battery "과충전 배터리" with "공격 속도 +16%" and coral "최대 체력 -8" and price 27; tiny glowing match "불사 성냥" with "치명적 피해에서 1회 생존" and coral "최대 체력 -10" and price 106. Each offer has one large floating OBJECT-ONLY icon, unobstructed name, aligned concise effect lines, a prominent "구매" button containing its price, separate unmistakable padlock control of at least 44px equivalent. The second offer is locked: show obvious padlock/border state. Tap item art or small info icon opens full details; do not add more button rows. Footer: "보유 아이템" on left, "지갑 240" near center, strong "다음 웨이브" button at bottom right. Keep ALL text inside dedicated allocated regions. Every offer's title, art, effects and buy button align horizontally with peer offers.
Constraints: only 4 offers, do not add inventory grids or extra windows. Korean text as specified. Values here are sample design content. No black square behind item art. No scrapbook, paper texture, torn edge, sticky notes, pastel construction-paper rectangles, realistic metal frames, excessive neon, clutter, gradients obscuring text, decorative text or watermark. Design must look substantially different from generic Godot rounded flat panels. Aim for tactile depth, dedicated hierarchy, careful mobile spacing.
Style direction B: "Seoul arcade". Bright, sophisticated cartoon urban arcade HUD inspired by Seoul street signs, modern Korean city wayfinding and portable game devices. Main surface pale cool grey, crisp deep-navy structural frames with real 3D rubber/plastic thickness and rounded corners. Warm tangerine action buttons with white text, bright cyan selection rail, ivory text fields. Small lane-mark and route-line motifs outside text regions give Seoul identity. One continuous urban shop rail houses four tall object display bays; strong type and clean ink outlines distinguish tiers without repeated pastel colored paper cards. Header looks like a friendly arcade city sign. Light environment overall, high contrast navy text. Strong sculpted button edges, contained orange/cyan accents, playful but polished. Avoid black military aesthetic, grunge, childish preschool UI or generic pastel dashboard.
